description: An illustration depicting the bustling scene of Sydney Harbour in Australia. The iconic Sydney Opera House stands at the center, with a large container ship and a small workboat sailing on the shimmering sea in the foreground. A red-white-blue passenger aircraft flies low in the sky above. The overall color scheme is dominated by blue-green tones, vividly presenting a dynamic scene of international trade and urban vitality.
